comment: Shoe size 9 feels like size 8. Very tight toe box and caused blisters on my first run.
Mouse scroll wheel stopped working after 3 days of light office use. Cursor lags intermittently.
Lid seal leaks water when tilted upside down. Rubber gasket inside cap was missing upon arrival.
Left ear cup audio completely cut out after 1 week. Active noise cancellation introduces static buzz.
Color faded significantly after first cold wash cycle. Fabric feels thinner than described.
Blade edge arrived chipped out of the box. Handle wooden grip was loose and wobbling.
Battery drains from 100% to 0% in under 4 hours even with screen brightness dimmed down.
Waist measurement is 2 inches smaller than standard sizing chart. Zipper gets stuck easily.
Nonstick coating started peeling off into food during second light stir fry cook.
HDMI port fails to output 4K video signal to external monitor. Power delivery port overheats.
